title: Resume All AGV Movement Through the OptiSweep WCS API
summary: Use the OptiSweep / WCS API through Apidog or an equivalent WCS API client to submit the POST ResumeAgvs operation, which requests Geek to resume movement for all paused AGVs. Verify the resulting fleet state through the WCS API AGV status view.
when_to_use: Use when all AGV movement was paused through the OptiSweep / WCS API and movement needs to be resumed through the live WCS API surface.
not_for: Do not use ResumeAgvs as a physical E-stop reset.
Do not use this procedure for physical AGV recovery or physical safety-stop reset.

roles_and_responsibilities.responsibility: Access the OptiSweep / WCS API through Apidog or an equivalent WCS API client, submit ResumeAgvs, and verify the live AGV status.

safety_notes: ResumeAgvs requests Geek to resume all AGV movement; it is not a physical E-stop reset.
access_or_tools_needed: Apidog or equivalent WCS API client
WCS API AGV status view, including Get Agv Statuses

access_required: L2/L3 access to the OptiSweep / WCS API
Access to Apidog or an equivalent WCS API client
system_preconditions: AGV movement is paused and the ResumeAgvs operation is appropriate for the current operating condition.

visual_references.description: OptiSweep / WCS API AGVs view showing the POST ResumeAgvs operation and its description that it requests Geek to resume all AGV movement.
OptiSweep / WCS API AGV status view showing current AGV state, command, vitals, AGV errors, system errors, status, and errorAlert fields.

steps.title: Locate ResumeAgvs in the OptiSweep / WCS API
steps.purpose: Identify the live API operation that requests Geek to resume movement for all paused AGVs.
steps.instruction: In Apidog or an equivalent OptiSweep / WCS API client, open the AGVs API operations and locate the operation labeled POST ResumeAgvs.
steps.expected_result: The AGVs API list displays POST ResumeAgvs and identifies it as the operation that requests Geek to resume all AGV movement.
steps.healthy_condition: The intended operation is clearly identified as POST ResumeAgvs under the AGVs API operations.
steps.failure_condition: POST ResumeAgvs is unavailable, cannot be located, or the WCS API client cannot display the AGVs operations.

actions.label: Open AGVs API operations
actions.exact_action: Open the AGVs API operations in Apidog or an equivalent OptiSweep / WCS API client.

actions.label: Locate ResumeAgvs
actions.exact_action: Locate the operation labeled POST ResumeAgvs.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the WCS API client cannot display or locate POST ResumeAgvs.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: ResumeAGVs will make a request to Geek to resume all AGV movement; the API list identifies POST ResumeAgvs.
OptiSweep provides APIs to get data and to make requests; Apidog is installed on the primary servers.

steps.title: Submit the POST ResumeAgvs request
steps.purpose: Send the live WCS API request to Geek to resume movement for the paused AGV fleet.
steps.instruction: Submit the POST ResumeAgvs request in Apidog or the equivalent OptiSweep / WCS API client.
steps.expected_result: The POST ResumeAgvs request is submitted to request that Geek resume all AGV movement.
steps.healthy_condition: The WCS API client accepts and submits the POST ResumeAgvs request without a submission failure.
steps.failure_condition: The request cannot be submitted or the WCS API client reports a submission failure.
stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the POST ResumeAgvs request cannot be submitted.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: ResumeAGVs will make a request to Geek to resume all AGV movement.

steps.title: Verify the live AGV fleet state
steps.purpose: Confirm that the resume request produced the intended live fleet behavior.
steps.instruction: Use the OptiSweep / WCS API AGV status view, including Get Agv Statuses, and observe the current AGV state, command, commandStatus, status, errorCode, errorDescription, errorCause, systemErrorDescription, systemErrorResolution, and errorAlert. Confirm through the available live fleet observation that AGV movement has resumed.
steps.expected_result: The live AGV status view reflects resumed movement for the previously paused fleet and provides current AGV state and error information for verification.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV status data is available, AGVs are no longer remaining paused, and the live status view does not show an active AGV or system error preventing movement. The status view can include fields such as state, commandName, commandStatus, status, errorCode, errorDescription, and errorAlert.
steps.failure_condition: AGV movement remains paused, the status view shows an active AGV or system error, or current AGV status cannot be retrieved.

actions.label: Retrieve AGV statuses
actions.exact_action: Use GET Get Agv Statuses in the OptiSweep / WCS API client.

actions.label: Observe fleet movement
actions.exact_action: Observe the live AGV fleet state and verify that AGV movement resumes.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if AGV movement remains paused after the ResumeAgvs request.
Stop and escalate if current AGV status cannot be retrieved.
Stop and escalate if the live status view shows an active AGV or system error preventing movement.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Get AGV status shows the current state of AGVs, their current command, vitals, AGV errors, and system errors; the displayed fields include state, commandName, commandStatus, status, errorCode, errorDescription, errorCause, systemErrorDescription, systemErrorResolution, and errorAlert.

success_criteria: POST ResumeAgvs is submitted successfully through the OptiSweep / WCS API.
The request is intended to resume all paused AGV movement through Geek.
The live WCS API AGV status view is available for verification.
AGV movement resumes and no active AGV or system error is preventing movement.
healthy_conditions: The AGV status view returns current AGV state, command, vitals, and error fields.
AGVs are no longer remaining paused after the ResumeAgvs request.
The live status view does not show an active AGV or system error preventing movement.
failure_conditions: POST ResumeAgvs cannot be located or submitted.
Current AGV status cannot be retrieved through the WCS API.
AGV movement remains paused after the request.
The AGV status view shows an active AGV or system error preventing movement.
escalation_guidance: Stop and escalate if the ResumeAgvs request cannot be submitted.
Stop and escalate if AGV movement remains paused after the request.
Stop and escalate if the live AGV status view cannot be retrieved or shows an active AGV or system error.
